purpose: Genuinely unseen confirmation of the locked V6A ordinary-session SGX A50 pre-auction price-discovery increment without allowing the cloud research branch to read, tune on, store or commit 2021-2025 China target rows or external market rows.
scientific_question: Does the same-contract SGX FTSE China A50 move accumulated from the previous mainland close to immediately before the next mainland opening call auction continue to add stable explanatory information about the CSI1000 09:31 opening gap beyond the frozen V5A comparator?

locked_candidate.training_rule: reproduce the frozen v6 common-sample training construction and complete-case handling exactly; do not use any 2021-2025 observation to fit scaler, coefficients, feature definitions, contract rules or missing-data rules

locked_comparator.definition: the same frozen v4 + holiday A50 feature family used as the comparator in the formal v6 experiment, trained only on the exact frozen 2015-2018 training construction
locked_comparator.purpose: measure the incremental value of the ordinary-session pre-auction A50 channel, not sample composition

manifest_requirements: China target source identifiers, local file hashes, row counts and date range
all external source identifiers and local file hashes
official SGX archive URL/key/SHA256 provenance for every consumed ordinary and holiday A50 endpoint
SGX schema identifier and blank-price/amend handling
China trading calendar and holiday_reopen construction/version
FRED/HKMA retrieval or frozen-source provenance and causal date clocks
explicit assertion that ordinary A50 uses zero target trades at or after 09:15:00
explicit assertion that frozen holiday A50 uses zero target trades at or after 09:25:00
explicit assertion that no 2021-2025 row was used to change the model or rules

target.name: CSI1000 next-session opening gap
target.formula: target China 09:31 open / previous China 15:00 close - 1
target.evaluation_objective: explanatory and directional quality, not trading PnL

feature_semantics.implementation_rule: reproduce the frozen v3/v4/v5/v6 code and clocks from the locked candidate code; do not reinterpret dates or market sessions for convenience
feature_semantics.US: preserve the frozen complete-clock U.S. daily and closure-extra construction using only observations available before the China target open
feature_semantics.HKMA_China_FX: preserve the frozen v4 clock correction and target-date observation prohibition

SGX_A50_holiday.definition: preserve the frozen V5A same-contract holiday closure feature exactly

SGX_A50_ordinary.contract_selection: nearest non-past CN contract month with an actual trade at or before previous China 15:00
SGX_A50_ordinary.start: last selected-contract trade at or before previous China 15:00:00
SGX_A50_ordinary.end: last same-contract trade strictly before target China 09:15:00, operational cutoff 09:14:59
SGX_A50_ordinary.legacy_schema_rule: resolve fields by normalized official header; legacy Y and later T are trade codes; S is settlement; nonblank amend records excluded; official blank-price trade-status rows are skipped record-by-record

external_source_rule.SGX_price_provider: Singapore Exchange official historical derivatives archives only
external_source_rule.date_to_key_navigation: a third-party date-to-SGX-key index may be used only as navigation if pinned/frozen before evaluating targets; all market-price bytes must come from official SGX archives
external_source_rule.missing_official_archive_or_same_contrac: mark unavailable and exclude the row from both V5A and V6A common-sample comparison; never impute, switch contracts or use future volume/open interest

holiday_subset: event-level fixed predictions and squared-error differences
coverage: SGX archive and same-contract endpoint coverage
concentration: remaining total gain after removing top1/top5/top10 positive contributors without refit

conditions: zero post-target leakage
zero ordinary A50 target endpoints at or after 09:15:00
zero frozen holiday A50 target endpoints at or after 09:25:00
all A50 intervals use the same selected contract at start and target
no future volume/open-interest contract selection
no mid-window roll or continuous-contract splice
no forward fill or interpolation that invents market observations
V5A and V6A metrics use an identical unseen common sample
zero 2021-2025 observations used for training or rule selection
V6A full-unseen R2 > V5A full-unseen R2
V6A full-unseen SSE < V5A full-unseen SSE
V6A full-unseen IC > V5A full-unseen IC
V6A sign-hit deterioration versus V5A is no worse than 0.01 absolute
V6A ordinary-subset SSE < V5A ordinary-subset SSE
V6A ordinary-subset IC >= V5A ordinary-subset IC
V6A ordinary-subset sign-hit deterioration versus V5A is no worse than 0.01 absolute
V6A improves calendar-year SSE versus V5A in at least 3 of the 5 years 2021-2025
V6A has nonnegative annual IC delta versus V5A in at least 3 of the 5 years 2021-2025
gate_3_multi_year_stability.reason: prevent one crisis year or one market regime from defining the unseen confirmation

conditions: report all calendar-quarter deltas without excluding bad quarters
report top1/top5/top10 fixed-prediction SSE-gain concentration
do not refit after removing contributors
gate_4_quarterly_and_concentration_diagn.reason: document stability and concentration without inventing a new post-hoc threshold after seeing the consumed holdout

conditions: V6A holiday-subset SSE <= V5A holiday-subset SSE
gate_5_holiday_preservation.sign_and_IC: report descriptively but do not create a new sign-hit threshold from the 11-event consumed-holdout caveat
gate_5_holiday_preservation.reason: the new ordinary feature is zero on holiday rows, but model refitting can redistribute coefficients; unseen confirmation must not buy ordinary-session fit by materially worsening holiday magnitude error

conditions: ordinary unseen A50 availability under the frozen contract is at least 0.90 of ordinary target rows
all unavailable rows have objective source/contract reasons and are removed from both comparator and candidate

decision_rule.gate_0_failure: invalidate_unseen_run_and repair data/schema/clock only; do not tune model or candidate
decision_rule.other_selection_gate_failure: do_not_promote_V6A; preserve the failure as confirmatory evidence and do not use 2021-2025 to tune a rescue
decision_rule.insufficient_coverage: retain V6A as research candidate only and do not impute or substitute a new source after seeing targets

forbidden_selection_inputs: using 2021-2025 to tune V6A, revive another candidate or define a regime model
